ulmuenster.name: Ulm Minster
ulmuenster.slogan: A spire that took 513 years to finish.
ulmuenster.line: Begun in 1377 and completed in 1890, its 161.5 m steeple held the record as the world's tallest church tower for 135 years.

ulblautopf.name: Blautopf
ulblautopf.slogan: A spring so blue the locals blame the ink.
ulblautopf.line: Eduard Mörike set the legend of the sad water-nymph Lau here, in the 1853 tale Das Stuttgarter Hutzelmännlein.

ullichtenstein.name: Lichtenstein Castle
ullichtenstein.slogan: A storybook castle perched on a cliff edge.
ullichtenstein.line: Built in 1840-42 for Count Wilhelm von Urach, it was inspired by Wilhelm Hauff's 1826 novel Lichtenstein.

ulhohlefels.name: Hohle Fels Cave
ulhohlefels.slogan: Where a 6 cm Venus has waited 40,000 years.
ulhohlefels.line: The Venus of Hohle Fels, about 41,000 years old, was found in 2008 and the cave is part of a UNESCO site since 2017.

ulschiefeshaus.name: Crooked House
ulschiefeshaus.slogan: Leaning over the Blau like it's eavesdropping.
ulschiefeshaus.line: This 16th-century house in Ulm's Fischerviertel is still in use today as a hotel.
